SOLUTIONS
Design, simulate, and analyse your photovoltaic projects with archelios PRO 
contact usBrochure
Trustpilot 
With the archelios PRO web application, you can design any type of photovoltaic project: from rooftop projects to large solar power plants. Feasibility and profitability studies, simulations, production calculations, the application is intended for all types of projects. 
Access the archelios PRO application:
Login 
The promises of archelios PRO
Layout
Location and 3D modelling of the installation.
Configuration
Layout, choice of inverter and automatic wiring of the tables.
Pre-sizing
Quick estimation of the output. (P50-P90) 
Project design
Detailed study and full report customization. 
Self-consumption
Supports all types of load curves.
Technical-economic study
Complete analysis with calculation of the return and payback time. (VAN/LCOE/TRI) 
Execution
Single-line schematics and execution plans. 
Features 
3D Conception 
Layout and automatic layout
Inverter configuration and automatic string wiring 
Simulation and production calculation 
Self-consumption analysis and energy storage
Economic analysis
Sizing Report
Project deliverables 
Brochure
archelios pro
Download 
References
archelios PRO is recognised by the following training organisations: 
INES / OPQIBI / FORMAPELEC 
Integration of more than 100 manufacturer catalogues
Shop
A range of photovoltaic software adapted to your activity

# SOLUTIONS

![Logo](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Badge-ENG-Solaire.svg)

![Logo formation](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/archelios-pro-dark-1.png)

Design, simulate, and analyse your photovoltaic projects with archelios PRO

[contact us](https://www.trace-software.com/en/contact/)[Brochure](https://contenu.trace-software.com/en/download-our-archelios-pro-software-brochure)

[Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/trace-software.com)

With the archelios PRO web application, you can design any type of photovoltaic project: from rooftop projects to large solar power plants. Feasibility and profitability studies, simulations, production calculations, the application is intended for all types of projects.

Access the archelios PRO application:

[Login](https://www.archelios.com/online/bin/Archelios-Online-Login.php?lang=en)

## The promises of archelios PRO

![trace-offre-complete](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-offre-complete-1.svg)

### Layout

Location and 3D modelling of the installation.

![trace-settings](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-settings-1.svg)

### Configuration

Layout, choice of inverter and automatic wiring of the tables.

![illustration1-1](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-1.svg)

### Pre-sizing

Quick estimation of the output. (P50-P90)

![trace-list-simple-](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-list-simple-1.svg)

### Project design

Detailed study and full report customization.

![trace-design](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-design.svg)

### Self-consumption

Supports all types of load curves.

![trace-predimensionnement](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-predimensionnement-1.svg)

### Technical-economic study

Complete analysis with calculation of the return and payback time. (VAN/LCOE/TRI)

![illustration2-1](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration2-1.svg)

### Execution

Single-line schematics and execution plans.

## Features

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-1-1.svg)

3D Conception

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-2.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-3.svg)

Layout and automatic layout

SOLUTIONS
Software specialized in electrical studies of solar projects 
contact usBrochure
Trustpilot 
For many years, archelios CALC has been supporting professionals in the electrical study of their solar projects, from photovoltaic panels to inverters and from inverters to grids.
Today, the needs in the field are evolving. Photovoltaic projects are no longer treated in isolation: they are integrated into a complete electrical installation, with uses, protections, connection constraints, sometimes EVSE and, depending on the case, an extension to the transformer or the HV network.
This is why Trace Software is evolving this approach towards elec calc SOLAR, a software that allows solar energy to be integrated directly into a global electrical project, from direct current to alternating current uses.
Find out more about elec calc solar 
archelios CALC’s promises
Electrical study of solar projects
Analysis of the main electrical parameters of the project, taking into account cables, protections and verification quantities.
Normative controls
Controls according to the standards supported by the software to support the study of solar installations.
Consideration of the installation context
Analysis of the project's environment: lightning risk, temperature, installation conditions, self-consumption and specific connection cases.
Technical reading of the project
Visualization of electrical curves and behaviors.
Deliverables
Generation of technical documents associated with the study.
Multi-Manufacturer Catalog
Access to a technical reference base to structure the study with the appropriate equipment.
Features
Choice of standard
The software allows you to work according to the standards supported in the archelios CALC environment, in order to remain consistent with the requirements of the project and the habits of your teams.
Connection of any installation type
Surge protection analysis
Choice of AC and DC installation modes
AC DC cable diameter calculation
Calculation of AC and DC protection type
Multi-manufacturer equipment list
Single line diagram in PDF and DWG formats
Material quantities (nomenclature)
Customisable design score
Brochure
archelios CALC
Download 
Standard
archelios CALC allows you to work according to the standards integrated into the software to support the electrical study of solar projects. This foundation has helped make the software a tool identified by many players in the industry.
Today, this expertise extends to elec calc SOLAR, which takes a more holistic approach by directly integrating solar energy into the complete electrical installation. 
Learn more 
Integration of more than 100 manufacturer catalogues

This is why Trace Software is evolving this approach towards **elec calc SOLAR,** a software that allows solar energy to be integrated directly into a global electrical project, from direct current to alternating current uses.

[Find out more about elec calc solar](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/elec-calc-solar-complete-pv-design-software-from-panel-to-ev-charging-point/)

## archelios CALC’s promises

![trace-offre-complete](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-offre-complete-1.svg)

### Electrical study of solar projects

Analysis of the main electrical parameters of the project, taking into account cables, protections and verification quantities.

![trace-settings](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-settings-1.svg)

### Normative controls

Controls according to the standards supported by the software to support the study of solar installations.

![trace-predimensionnement](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-predimensionnement-1.svg)

### Consideration of the installation context

Analysis of the project's environment: lightning risk, temperature, installation conditions, self-consumption and specific connection cases.

![trace-design](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-design.svg)

### Technical reading of the project

Visualization of electrical curves and behaviors.

![illustration1-4](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-4.svg)

### Deliverables

Generation of technical documents associated with the study.

![illustration2-1](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration2-1.svg)

### Multi-Manufacturer Catalog

Access to a technical reference base to structure the study with the appropriate equipment.

SOLUTIONS
Design and size your High and Low Voltage electrical installations 
Contact usBook a demo 
Trustpilot 
elec calc is a calculation software for the design of all types of high and low voltage architecture according to the corresponding national and/or international standards. 
Its user-friendly interface has been designed to bring flexibility and productivity to the design of your projects. The software will accompany you to ensure both the compliance and optimisation of your installation. 
Explore features 
elec calc's promises
Optimised power grid design
With elec calc, accurately model your grid architecture to optimise the energy efficiency and reliability of your facilities. 
Accurate cable sizing
Ensure the safety and performance of your electrical systems with cable cross-section calculations that take into account the latest standards and technologies.
Intelligent Protective Device Selection
Simplify your protective equipment selection with an ever-growing multi-manufacturer database for seamless and cost-effective integration. 
Rigorous Electrical Risk Assessment
Accurately assess short-circuit currents, which are critical to the safety of your facilities, controlling risks and ensuring compliance with international safety standards.
Features
Exceptional Compute Performance
Thanks to its powerful calculation engine, elec calc offers the advantage of verifying, in real time, all the calculations of the installation (ICC, voltage drops, harmonics, power balance, etc.)
Simulation of all operating scenarios
Simulate and control different installation configurations (normal operation, load shedding, maintenance, etc.)
If you draw it, it's calculated
Unique in the calculation software market, the freehand conception of an electrical diagram offers a flexibility that is essential for the design and verification of the most complex installations.
State-of-the-art know-how 
Design features, such as the Intellisense system, accelerate project design in an intuitive way by highlighting components that can feasibly be connected to the current selection.
An accelerator for your international development
Compliant with standards, NF C15-100, NF C13-200, and also IEC standards. RGIE, NEN, NIBT, REBT, BS, VDE.
Precision saves money
The software’s precision makes it possible to reduce the hardware required, in compliance with the regulations in force. It also makes it enables clearer and more precise responses to tenders and/or large-scale savings on a project.
A real time saver 
For greater efficiency and above all speed, a library of standard plans can be customised by the user.
Enhanced security 
Ability to describe the geographical environment of the facility using the location manager. Contour plots and reports are available for each location.
A multi-manufacturer catalogue
The user has access to a database of more than 100,000 references available for all components, so elec calc will offer you the best reference according to your preferences. 
The database can also be expanded manually, and managed in your user catalogue
Easy editing, export and printing 
The modification and export of synoptics and layouts can be done in PDF and DWG formats. The design notes can be configured and edited in PDF format, and if necessary in a language different from that of the interface. 
Brochure
elec calc
Download 
Standards
The calculation methods used in elec calc are based on the standards used and the personal safety regulations in force in different countries. 

elec calc complies with IEC standards, but other standards are implemented to meet the specific requirements of the country (BS Standard for Great Britain, NF for France, RGIE/AREI Regulation for Belgium, NIBT Standard for Switzerland, REBT Standard for Spain, VDE Standard for Germany, NEN Standard for the Netherlands) 
Learn more 
Integration of over 150 manufacturer catalogs
Shop
A range of electrical calculation programs adapted to your activity
Whether you are an installer, a design consultancy, an operator, a project owner, or a control office, there is version of elec calc adapted to your needs. The tool’s user-friendly and ergonomic interface will allow you to work with features tailored to your project.
Identify your need 
Testimonies
They chose elec calc
"In elec calc, it is very easy to manage several operating modes on the same installation as well as several sources"
Yann Le Saout Study manager, Actemium
Discover all the testimonials
"We were able to resume almost fifteen years of work on our facilities, which we wanted to keep and continue to develop. All our files have been processed in the new software, and now that we've been trained, we can continue to develop them with peace of mind."
Jean-Christophe Gandon
Technical Manager - EIA Department - Oril Industrie, Servier Group
Discover all the testimonials
"With Trace Software, we attended a presentation performed with a very educational approach. Our problem was understood and we were able to discover modern and ergonomic software with a relevant approach for our needs."
Alexandre BODET Associate director of B2E
Discover all the testimonials
"The elec calc tool is versatile with support for both high and low voltage in the same project, which is a strong point."
Alexandre Rondeau SPIE Nuclear design office manager
Discover all the testimonials
"The integration of the manufacturers' hardware and the precision of the software allowed us to deliver an accurate study which highlighted the need to replace the existing equipment and thus guarantee the continuity of operation of the building."
Lionel Pereira
Industrial designer, Swissohm design office

# SOLUTIONS

![Logo](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Badge-ENG-Electricite.svg)

![Logo formation](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/eleccalc-light-1-1.svg)

Design and size your High and Low Voltage electrical installations

[Contact us](https://www.trace-software.com/en/contact/)[Book a demo](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/electrical-installations-calculation-software/#) 

[Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/trace-software.com)

elec calc is a calculation software for the design of all types of high and low voltage architecture according to the corresponding national and/or international standards. 

Its user-friendly interface has been designed to bring flexibility and productivity to the design of your projects. The software will accompany you to ensure both the compliance and optimisation of your installation.

[Explore features](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/electrical-installations-calculation-software/#FonctionnalitesECEN)

## elec calc's promises

![trace-offre-complete](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-offre-complete-1.svg)

### Optimised power grid design

With elec calc, accurately model your grid architecture to optimise the energy efficiency and reliability of your facilities.

![trace-settings](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-settings-1.svg)

### Accurate cable sizing

Ensure the safety and performance of your electrical systems with cable cross-section calculations that take into account the latest standards and technologies.

![trace-predimensionnement](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-predimensionnement-1.svg)

### Intelligent Protective Device Selection

Simplify your protective equipment selection with an ever-growing multi-manufacturer database for seamless and cost-effective integration.

![trace-design](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-design.svg)

### Rigorous Electrical Risk Assessment

Accurately assess short-circuit currents, which are critical to the safety of your facilities, controlling risks and ensuring compliance with international safety standards.

## Features

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-1-1.svg)

Exceptional Compute Performance

Thanks to its powerful calculation engine, elec calc offers the advantage of verifying, in real time, all the calculations of the installation (ICC, voltage drops, harmonics, power balance, etc.)

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration3.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration2.svg)

Simulation of all operating scenarios

Simulate and control different installation configurations (normal operation, load shedding, maintenance, etc.)

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration3-1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration2-2.svg)

If you draw it, it's calculated

Unique in the calculation software market, the freehand conception of an electrical diagram offers a flexibility that is essential for the design and verification of the most complex installations.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration5-1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration4-1.svg)

State-of-the-art know-how

Design features, such as the _Intellisense_  system, accelerate project design in an intuitive way by highlighting components that can feasibly be connected to the current selection.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-1-1.svg)

An accelerator for your international development

Compliant with standards, NF C15-100, NF C13-200, and also IEC standards. RGIE, NEN, NIBT, REBT, BS, VDE.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-2.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-3.svg)

Precision saves money

The software’s precision makes it possible to reduce the hardware required, in compliance with the regulations in force. It also makes it enables clearer and more precise responses to tenders and/or large-scale savings on a project.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration2-3.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/illustration1-1.svg)

A real time saver

For greater efficiency and above all speed, a library of standard plans can be customised by the user.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/illustration-3.svg)

Enhanced security

Ability to describe the geographical environment of the facility using the location manager. Contour plots and reports are available for each location.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-2.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-1.svg)

A multi-manufacturer catalogue

The user has access to a database of more than 100,000 references available for all components, so elec calc will offer you the best reference according to your preferences. 

_The_ _database_ _can also be expanded manually, and managed in your user catalogue_

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration3-2.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/trace-offre-complete-lg-1.svg)

Easy editing, export and printing

The modification and export of synoptics and layouts can be done in PDF and DWG formats. The design notes can be configured and edited in PDF format, and if necessary in a language different from that of the interface. 

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec1-e1733736582572.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec2-e1733736486780.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec3-e1733736428260.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec4-e1733736792488.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec5-e1733736814217.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec5-e1733736814217.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec6.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/ec7.png)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/ec8-e1733736849809.jpg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/ec9-e1733736870548.jpg)

### Standards

The calculation methods used in elec calc are based on the standards used and the personal safety regulations in force in different countries.  
  
elec calc complies with IEC standards, but other standards are implemented to meet the specific requirements of the country (BS Standard for Great Britain, NF for France, RGIE/AREI Regulation for Belgium, NIBT Standard for Switzerland, REBT Standard for Spain, VDE Standard for Germany, NEN Standard for the Netherlands)

[Learn more](https://www.trace-software.com/en/standards/)

Design, calculate and simulate your PV installations up to 9 kWp for free

archelios PRO Free: Calculate your photovoltaic installation up to 9kWp
archelios PRO Free is a professional program for the design, calculation, and simulation of your PV project up to 9 kWp, FREE OF CHARGE.
Whether you are an installer, an educational center, or a young company, and your projects do not exceed a power of 9 kWp, the software archelios PRO Free is the best option for you.
Discover our other ranges to go further:
Discover all our offers 
The promises of archelios PRO Free
Design
projects for grid-connected or self-consumption solar installations
Precise calculation of the expected production
An accurate economic analysis 
for the best estimation of the return on investment.
Simple and user-friendly 
Both for users who are new to photovoltaic design and for users who have more experience in this type of projects.
Features
Maximum Power: 9 kWp
Inverters & modules sizing
It includes advanced functionalities and assistance for the sizing of inverters and photovoltaic modules. With an extensive database of inverters, once the manufacturer is chosen, archelios PRO will propose to you which inverter configuration to use according to the photovoltaic project.
Production forecast
With archelios PRO you can calculate the solar potential of the modules taking into account the environment and environmental conditions from the METEONORM meteorological database. In addition, it automatically calculates the horizon mask that can affect the performance of the panels, thus obtaining an accurate calculation of the photovoltaic production estimate.
Economic analysis
archelios PRO provides economic results and bank indicators that will give the user visibility of the cost of the installation and its profitability, as well as the return on investment.
Management of PV installations for self-consumption
The system allows to carry out a simulation of self-consumption projects with a storage option based on self-consumption profiles, based on annual billing, and production calculations.
Web application and secure data
Licence validity: 1 year
Quick and easy access to the application

Design, calculate and simulate your PV installations up to 9 kWp for free

[Request](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/archelios-pro-free-free-pv-design-software/#formulaire-apfree-en)[Discover premium versions](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/archelios-pro-free-free-pv-design-software/#gammes-ap-en)

archelios PRO Free: Calculate your photovoltaic installation up to 9kWp

**archelios PRO Free is a professional program for the design, calculation, and simulation of your PV project up to 9 kWp, FREE OF CHARGE.**

Whether you are an installer, an educational center, or a young company, and your projects do not exceed a power of 9 kWp, the software archelios PRO Free is the best option for you.  
Discover our other ranges to go further:

[Discover all our offers](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-solutions/archelios-pro-free-free-pv-design-software/#gammes-ap-en)

## The promises of archelios PRO Free

![trace-offre-complete](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-offre-complete-1.svg)

### Design

projects for grid-connected or self-consumption solar installations

![trace-settings](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-settings-1.svg)

### Precise calculation of the expected production

![illustration-3](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-3.svg)

### An accurate economic analysis

for the best estimation of the return on investment.

![trace-design](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-design.svg)

### Simple and user-friendly

Both for users who are new to photovoltaic design and for users who have more experience in this type of projects.

## Features  
Maximum Power: 9 kWp

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/aPRO4-EN.png)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/aPRO4-FR.png)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/aPRO4-EN.png)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/aPRO4-EN.png)

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/illustration-2.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/illustration.png)

Inverters & modules sizing

It includes advanced functionalities and assistance for the **sizing of inverters and photovoltaic modules**. With an extensive database of inverters, once the manufacturer is chosen, archelios PRO will propose to you which inverter configuration to use according to the photovoltaic project.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration7.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-graph-lg-1.svg)

Production forecast

With archelios PRO you can **calculate the solar potential of the modules** taking into account the environment and environmental conditions from the METEONORM meteorological database. In addition, it **automatically calculates the horizon mask** that can affect the performance of the panels, thus obtaining an accurate calculation of the photovoltaic production estimate.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration5-1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/illustration2.svg)

Economic analysis

archelios PRO provides **economic results** and bank indicators that will give the user **visibility of the cost of the installation and its profitability**, as well as the return on investment.

![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration-1.svg)![](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration1-4.svg)

Management of PV installations for self-consumption

The system allows to carry out a **simulation of self-consumption projects** with a storage option based on self-consumption profiles, based on annual billing, and production calculations.

![illustration5-1](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/illustration5-1.svg)

Solutions
From the panel to the charging station, a single sizing tool

Trustpilot 
From the photovoltaic installation to the charging station, design and size your entire electrical project in a single environment. 
From the photovoltaic installation to the charging station, design and size your entire electrical project in a single environment.
A unified approach to photovoltaic sizing
The design of a photovoltaic installation involves dimensioning both the DC module chains, the inverter and its integration into the electrical installation. These steps are still often carried out with separate tools, generating re-entry, inconsistencies and waste of time.
elec calc SOLAR offers a unified approach: the photovoltaic system is integrated directly into the electrical installation, within a single environment. Developed from the elec calc range, the software ensures continuity from DC sizing to alternating current uses, in accordance with the international standards BS, NEN, NIBT, AREI, VDE, REBT, NF and IEC 60364-7-712.
elec calc SOLAR thus makes it possible to design photovoltaics within the same project as a complete and seamless electrical installation.
Discover the features 
Depending on the needs of the project, the study can also be extended to the HV network, offering a global vision of the electrical dimensioning, thanks to the SOLAR module :
The promises of elec calc SOLAR
Global management of your photovoltaic projects
Design and size your entire electrical installation in a single project, from the photovoltaic panel to the site's consumption.
Faster and more secure design
Structure your projects more efficiently, reduce re-entry and secure your calculations to ensure the overall consistency of your installations.
Precise and optimized sizing
Automatic proposal of the most suitable cable sections and protection devices according to technical and normative constraints.
Your technical documentation, ready in one click
Automatically generate the entire technical file: calculation note, electrical diagrams, detailed bills of materials.
The software is ELIE BT 2025 approved, a standard recognized by control offices, guaranteeing the reliability and compliance of electrical studies. 
A comprehensive and scalable multi-manufacturer database
Access a wide selection of hardware that is regularly updated. Easily select the components needed for the project (photovoltaic modules, photovoltaic inverters, electrical protection (surge protectors, circuit breakers, fuses, etc.))
Automatically retrieve the characteristics necessary for your studies. 
Continuity with archelios PRO
Import your archelios PRO projects directly into elec calc SOLAR in order to retrieve the architecture of the installation without re-entering or data loss.
Ensuring compliance and expertise
With more than 35 years of experience, Trace Software provides you with recognized solutions and an expert support team to ensure the success of your projects.
Features
Intelligent, free modeling
Model your facilities without constraints, thanks to the integrated IntelliSense technology.
Free modeling without predefined architectures
Logical association of the installation's components
Representation of photovoltaic chains, MPPTs and inverters
Integration of electrical uses (EVSE, self-consumption, etc.)
Global electrical sizing
Design your entire facility in a unified approach.
Definition of cable protection and cross-sections
Power flow analysis for dimensioning and connection
Real-time power balance
Built-in compliance and security
Secure your studies with automated prescriptive controls.
Application of CEI 60364-7-712, BS, NEN, NIBT, AREI, VDE, REBT and NF and standards
Lightning analysis and surge arrester management
Integrated electrical connection
Ensure continuity of sizing to the connection point.
Low-voltage dimensioning
HV transformer integration
Automated technical documentation
Generate your deliverables in one click.
Electrical diagrams
Bill of materials
ELIE BT 2025 approved design notes
Already a user of elec calc? 
If you are already using elec calc, you can simply add the SOLAR module to integrate the sizing of photovoltaic installations into your projects.
By combining the SOLAR module with elec calc (HV/LV, BIM or GRID), you can extend the sizing of your photovoltaic power plants up to HVA.
Thus, model and size all HV substations in accordance with IEC 61936-1 and IEC 60909. 
Find out more about the SOLAR module

elec calc SOLAR enables complete DC-side design with automatic compliance checks according to IEC 60364-7-712, then continues the study on the AC side through to the connection point (low voltage network, medium voltage connection or HV/LV substation) in compliance with IEC 60364.

From the photovoltaic installation to the charging station, design and size your entire electrical project in a single environment.

From the photovoltaic installation to the charging station, design and size your entire electrical project in a single environment.

A unified approach to photovoltaic sizing

The design of a photovoltaic installation involves dimensioning both the DC module chains, the inverter and its integration into the electrical installation. These steps are still often carried out with separate tools, generating re-entry, inconsistencies and waste of time.

elec calc SOLAR offers a unified approach: the photovoltaic system is integrated directly into the electrical installation, within a single environment. Developed from the elec calc range, the software ensures continuity from DC sizing to alternating current uses, in accordance with the international standards BS, NEN, NIBT, AREI, VDE, REBT, NF and IEC 60364-7-712.

elec calc SOLAR thus makes it possible to design photovoltaics within the same project as a complete and seamless electrical installation.

Discover the features

Depending on the needs of the project, the study can also be extended to the HV network, offering a global vision of the electrical dimensioning, thanks to the SOLAR module :

The promises of elec calc SOLAR

Global management of your photovoltaic projects

Design and size your entire electrical installation in a single project, from the photovoltaic panel to the site's consumption.

Faster and more secure design

Structure your projects more efficiently, reduce re-entry and secure your calculations to ensure the overall consistency of your installations.

Precise and optimized sizing

Automatic proposal of the most suitable cable sections and protection devices according to technical and normative constraints.

Your technical documentation, ready in one click

Automatically generate the entire technical file: calculation note, electrical diagrams, detailed bills of materials.
The software is ELIE BT 2025 approved, a standard recognized by control offices, guaranteeing the reliability and compliance of electrical studies.

A comprehensive and scalable multi-manufacturer database

Access a wide selection of hardware that is regularly updated. Easily select the components needed for the project (photovoltaic modules, photovoltaic inverters, electrical protection (surge protectors, circuit breakers, fuses, etc.))
Automatically retrieve the characteristics necessary for your studies.

Continuity with archelios PRO

Import your archelios PRO projects directly into elec calc SOLAR in order to retrieve the architecture of the installation without re-entering or data loss.

Ensuring compliance and expertise

With more than 35 years of experience, Trace Software provides you with recognized solutions and an expert support team to ensure the success of your projects.

Features

Intelligent, free modeling

Model your facilities without constraints, thanks to the integrated IntelliSense technology.

  • Free modeling without predefined architectures
  • Logical association of the installation's components
  • Representation of photovoltaic chains, MPPTs and inverters
  • Integration of electrical uses (EVSE, self-consumption, etc.)

Global electrical sizing

Design your entire facility in a unified approach.

  • Definition of cable protection and cross-sections
  • Power flow analysis for dimensioning and connection
  • Real-time power balance

Built-in compliance and security

Secure your studies with automated prescriptive controls.

  • Application of CEI 60364-7-712, BS, NEN, NIBT, AREI, VDE, REBT and NF and standards
  • Lightning analysis and surge arrester management

Integrated electrical connection

Ensure continuity of sizing to the connection point.

  • Low-voltage dimensioning
  • HV transformer integration

Automated technical documentation

Generate your deliverables in one click.

  • Electrical diagrams
  • Bill of materials
  • ELIE BT 2025 approved design notes

Already a user of elec calc?

If you are already using elec calc, you can simply add the SOLAR module to integrate the sizing of photovoltaic installations into your projects.
By combining the SOLAR module with elec calc (HV/LV, BIM or GRID), you can extend the sizing of your photovoltaic power plants up to HVA.
Thus, model and size all HV substations in accordance with IEC 61936-1 and IEC 60909.

Training Course 
With the photovoltaic calculation software archelios pro, you can design any type of photovoltaic project, wherever you are.
Contact usBrochure
The ONLINE archelios PRO training lasts 7 hours, spread over one working day. This training session aims to help you get started with the functionalities of the archelios PRO photovoltaic design and calculation application.
Description of the archelios PRO training course
Objectives
The archelios PRO online training session aims to help you get started with the photovoltaic design and calculation application.
Public
This course is aimed at users or designers, managers of photovoltaic installations, business engineers, and design office staff. All entities responsible for designing, studying or building PV installations. 
Contents
The trainer, following the established plan, explains all the application’s functionalities and the standard design process for the conception of a photovoltaic installation.
Requirements
A good understanding of how to design a photovoltaic installations, as well as the current NF and/or IEC standards. 
Implementation
All the theoretical notions will be illustrated by real world scenarios using archelios PRO. 
Pricing
Check out Trace Software’s training course tariffs
Download the brochure 
Program
In this training module, participants will familiarise themselves with the different functionalities enabling them to simulate, 
design and analyse their photovoltaic installations. Participants will discover the different stages of project design:
3D Modelling 
Integration of modules/inverters and cabling
Calculating energy production
Self-consumption and consumption profiles
Report and Deliverables
Sizing report and deliverables
In order for the training to take place in the best conditions, it is necessary to install Microsoft TEAMS on your workstation. 
Limited places
Pickup
FOR BELGIUM 
Are you an employer of CPC 149.01? Do not hesitate to contact Volta! Volta pays a premium of up to € 15.50 per hour if an employee of your company completes an approved training course and you meet the criteria. 
More info? www.volta-org.be, 02 476 16 76 or contact your regional advisor!

# Training Course

With the photovoltaic calculation software archelios pro, you can design any type of photovoltaic project, wherever you are.

[Contact us](https://www.trace-software.com/en/our-services/trace-software-training/training-course-archelios-pro/#contact-formation-ap-en)[Brochure](https://contenu.trace-software.com/en/download-our-trace-software-training-brochure)

The ONLINE archelios PRO training lasts 7 hours, spread over one working day. This training session aims to help you **get started with the functionalities of the archelios PRO photovoltaic design and calculation application.**

## Description of the archelios PRO training course

![trace-target](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-target-lg-1-1.svg)

### Objectives

The archelios PRO online training session aims to help you get started with the photovoltaic design and calculation application.

![trace-cloud-lg](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-cloud-lg-1.svg)

### Public

This course is aimed at users or designers, managers of photovoltaic installations, business engineers, and design office staff. All entities responsible for designing, studying or building PV installations.

![trace-exchange-lg](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-exchange-lg-1.svg)

### Contents

The trainer, following the established plan, explains all the application’s functionalities and the standard design process for the conception of a photovoltaic installation.

![trace-list-lg](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-list-lg-1.svg)

### Requirements

A good understanding of how to design a photovoltaic installations, as well as the current NF and/or IEC standards.

![trace-execution-lg](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-execution-lg-1.svg)

### Implementation

All the theoretical notions will be illustrated by real world scenarios using archelios PRO.

In this training module, participants will familiarise themselves with the different functionalities enabling them to simulate, 

design and analyse their photovoltaic installations. Participants will discover the different stages of project design:

![trace-design-](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-design-1.svg)

3D Modelling

![trace-offre-complete](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-offre-complete-1.svg)

Integration of modules/inverters and cabling

![trace-news](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-news-1.svg)

Calculating energy production

![trace-predimensionnement](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-predimensionnement-1.svg)

Self-consumption and consumption profiles

![trace-flexibilite](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-flexibilite-1.svg)

Report and Deliverables

![trace-switches](https://www.trace-software.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/trace-switches-1.svg)

Sizing report and deliverables

In order for the training to take place in the best conditions, it is necessary to install Microsoft TEAMS on your workstation[.](https://www.microsoft.com/fr-fr/microsoft-365/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software)

项目最大容量: 36 kWp
通过 archelios™ Pro Free ，您可以设计36 kWp以内的任何光伏项目，如小型光伏屋顶、家用和小型工业项目，无需高细节要求。
逆变器&组件选型
包括强大的功能和逆变器与光伏组件选型助手。包含庞大的逆变器选型库，一旦选择了制造商品牌，archelios™ Pro 将根据项目向您推荐使用哪种逆变器配置。
自用消耗光伏系统管理
软件可以对自发自用光伏项目进行模拟，并根据自消耗配置、根据年度账单和产量计算提供储能建议。
产量预测
通过 archelios™ Pro 您可以根据气象数据库中的环境和条件计算组件的光伏发电潜力。此外，它还自动计算会影响组件性能的水平阴影，从而获得光伏发电量估算的准确计算。
经济性分析
archelios™ Pro 提供了经济结果和银行指标，这些指标让用户能够看到安装成本及其盈利能力，以及投资回报率。
